no-restricted-syntax.message: Hand-written fetch is banned outside src/utils/api.ts (ADR-0001 §4). Use the generated client from '@/utils/api' so a contract change breaks the build rather than a user's session. WebSocket traffic is plane 2 and uses `new WebSocket`, which this rule does not match; the one legitimate raw fetch (the S3 presigned upload, which is not a gateway path) lives in api.ts and is exempted below.

Raw hex colour is banned outside the two definition sites (ADR-0013). Colour is defined once in src/app/globals.css :root and src/utils/theme.ts, and referenced everywhere else: var(--color-*) in CSS/styled-jsx, the UI table in DOM TS, BARROW/BARROW_HEX in Phaser TS (ADR-0025: DOM never reads BARROW). A new UI colour is a :root token and a UI-table entry first, then referenced. This covers inline style={{}} objects and third-party theme configs (Stripe Elements) too, which no CSS-only rule would reach.

Raw hex colour is banned outside the two definition sites (ADR-0013) — including inside template literals and styled-jsx blocks. Use var(--color-*), or UI.* where a literal is unavoidable (BARROW.* in Phaser code only).

Raw non-neutral rgb()/rgba() colour is banned outside the token definitions (ADR-0013, FS-8TCN2 slice 2). A palette triple typed at the call site does not move when the palette does. Derive it from a token instead: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brass) 15%, transparent) for an alpha variant, or add a token to globals.css :root first. Neutral black and white (0,0,0 / 255,255,255) may stay literal.

Raw non-neutral rgb()/rgba() colour is banned outside the token definitions (ADR-0013, FS-8TCN2 slice 2), including inside template literals and styled-jsx blocks. Use color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-*) N%, transparent) or a token.
Hand-written fetch is banned outside src/utils/api.ts (ADR-0001 section 4).
